subject: Quick thought on Elia's website and waterfront menu layout
body: Hi Triinu, I recently spent an evening exploring Elia on the River and love what you have built—especially the dock-and-dine setup and your vibrant weekend brunches against the Miami sunset. While browsing your current site on my phone, I noticed a couple of minor friction points, such as the redundant menu pages and event details that are a bit tricky to find on mobile. I took the liberty of putting together a modern, high-performance prototype for Elia that streamlines your menus, adds quick mobile call buttons, and optimizes the booking flow. You can check out the live preview here: https://elia-preview.pages.dev. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Consolidated redundant menu pages into a streamlined showcase
Added direct phone click-to-call buttons in the sticky mobile header
Optimized email capture and event booking flow with instant success messaging
